title: Invertibility of the evaluation comparison
statement: For l, E, L, ι, X, tensor presentations a and b, and complete ambient inputs K and M with hK and hM, the evaluation comparison v l E L ι X a b K M hK hM is an isomorphism.

proof.text: After restriction of scalars, a finite free basis identifies both Hom complexes with finite sums of RHom complexes. Exact scalar extension preserves K-injective representatives, and the evaluation transpose is the identity on each basis component. Restriction detects quasi-isomorphisms; conjugating by the completion isomorphisms gives invertibility of `v`.
